# LagDetector

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** LagDetector

## What it does

Prints a message in chat/on screen when the server is lagging

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/LagDetector.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
